title: The **Prime-Embedded Quantum Homology and Cohomology Algorithm (PEQHCA)** integrates **prime-number encoding** into the concepts of **homology** and **cohomology** within the context of **quantum systems**. **Homology** and **cohomology** are mathematical tools from algebraic topology that provide a way to study the properties of spaces by analyzing the relationships between their constituent parts. In quantum systems, these concepts can be extended to describe the structure of **quantum states**, **quantum fields**, and **entanglement** in terms of **cycles**, **boundaries**, and **quantum operators**.
